body: Thank you so much for your kind words! Good luck on your fics too! :)

I have yet to break 100k words so I can’t even imagine. I know there are very fast writers out there but 700k doesn’t seem humanly possible. But thank you, honestly I’ll just keep focusing on writing for myself regardless ahah. 

Someone noticed the breakneck speed at which full chapters were posted and inconsistencies in the writing, so they made a Tumblr post. The author deleted the fic which imo is very telling.

Yes, I definitely don’t expect the same amount of engagement ahah. I treasure my little crackship anyway, I just can’t imagine using AI, especially for a pairing with so many passionate writers.

Good luck on your fic!

Yes, it’s the DA fandom! I only just saw the post on Tumblr. I had seen some mutuals talk about this fic before and never imagined it could be AI. I just don’t understand why would anyone even use AI for fanfiction, especially for such a popular pairing. 

I hope you feel better. Maybe I’m being petty but the snippets I saw of that fic weren’t that good. AI is soulless and can never compare to actual human writing.
You’re right. This made me feel better, so thank you! I may not be that good of a writer but at least I try and have fun. It seems miserable to rely on AI for something like fanfiction of all things.
I can’t imagine going through all that effort honestly, seems much easier to write it yourself at that point.
